description:
kith-store/src/chat.rs:CHAT_SELECT_COLS (line 39) embeds a correlated subquery for unread_count:
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.chat_id = c.id AND m.delivery_state = 'received' AND m.read_at IS NULL) AS unread_count

This correlated subquery runs once per chat row in every list(), get(), and find_direct_by_contact_id() call. V7 migration adds a partial index (messages_unread) specifically to accelerate this subquery, documented in SCHEMA_V7 comment.

The constant itself has no comment linking it to the V7 index. A new reader looking at CHAT_SELECT_COLS might flag the correlated subquery as expensive without knowing the partial index exists. Adding a one-line comment '-- accelerated by messages_unread partial index (V7)' inline in the constant string (or in a Rust doc comment above it) would make the performance story self-contained.
title: READABILITY: CHAT_SELECT_COLS constant has unread_count correlated subquery with no performance note
